stories.headline: EXCLUSIVE: Iranian Official Outlines Latest Proposal to End the U.S. War as Trump Weighs New Strikes
stories.summary: Iran has proposed a 14-point plan to end the war with the US in 30 days. The plan includes demands for sanctions relief, troop withdrawal, and reopening the Strait of Hormuz. The proposal comes as President Donald Trump weighs new military strikes. Iran's offer aims to permanently end the conflict, which has exposed the limits of US military dominance. The plan requires the US to lift sanctions and end its naval blockade in exchange for a cessation of hostilities. The US is reviewing the proposal, which also includes conditions for the withdrawal of US troops. The proposal is Iran's latest diplomatic effort to resolve the conflict, and its success depends on Trump's response to the offer. The 30-day timeline for the plan's implementation adds urgency to the negotiations.

stories.headline: Ivanka Trump ‘targeted in Iran-backed assassination plot’
stories.summary: Ivanka Trump, daughter of former President Donald Trump, was allegedly targeted in an assassination plot linked to an Iran-backed extremist. The plot is believed to be revenge for the 2020 killing of Qasem Soleimani, a top Iranian military commander. An Iraqi operative, 32-year-old Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood Al-Saadi, was charged in 2026 with plotting to assassinate Ivanka Trump. The suspect, reportedly trained by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), was arrested in Turkey and extradited to the US. US authorities uncovered the sophisticated plot, which was described as a revenge-driven operation linked to Iran-backed militant networks. The suspect allegedly targeted Ivanka Trump as part of this revenge plot, according to federal law enforcement and intelligence officials.

stories.headline: 'Revenge matter of time': IRGC-trained Iraqi arrested over assassination plot against Donald Trump's daughter Ivanka
stories.summary: An Iraqi national, Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood Al-Saadi, 32, was arrested and charged with plotting to assassinate Ivanka Trump, daughter of former US President Donald Trump. The suspect, trained by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), allegedly sought revenge for the 2020 killing of Iranian military commander Qasem Soleimani. Al-Saadi was captured in Turkey and extradited to the US, where he faces charges of providing material support to Iranian-backed terrorist organizations and directing attacks on US citizens and interests. The plot was reportedly a revenge effort, with Al-Saadi pledging to kill Ivanka Trump. The arrest and charges mark a significant development in the case, highlighting ongoing tensions between the US and Iran. Al-Saadi's alleged actions demonstrate the reach of IRGC-trained operatives and their potential to target US citizens.

stories.headline: Australia Secures 600,000 Barrels of Jet Fuel from China to Prevent Flight Cancellations, Airport Disruptions, and Holiday Travel Chaos Across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and Perth: New Airline News
stories.summary: Australia has secured 600,000 barrels of jet fuel from China to prevent flight cancellations and airport disruptions. The move aims to mitigate potential holiday travel chaos in major cities like Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and Perth. A recent global report highlighted Australian airlines as highly exposed to jet fuel supply shortages, with prices already surging due to global tensions. The country's fuel reserves were critically low, prompting concerns about the impact on air travel. The shipment from China is expected to alleviate some of the pressure on Australia's fuel supply, following earlier shipments of petrol and diesel. The securing of jet fuel comes after some airlines, such as Jetstar, had already begun canceling flights due to supply concerns, with 1 in 10 flights canceled in September.

stories.headline: WiFi Can Identify People With Near-Perfect Accuracy Researchers in Germany are warning that ordinary WiFi networks could become a powerful new form of invisible surveillance.
stories.summary: Researchers in Germany have demonstrated a system that uses standard wireless signals and artificial intelligence to identify people with near-perfect accuracy. This technology utilizes ordinary WiFi networks, raising concerns about invisible surveillance. The system can track individuals without the need for cameras, smartphones, or consent. German researchers at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology have shown that WiFi routers can be used to silently identify people, sparking fears about digital privacy. The discovery highlights the need for a legal framework to protect radio-signal privacy and include WiFi-based tracking under data protection laws and cyber regulations. This development has significant implications for surveillance and privacy, as WiFi networks are ubiquitous and can be used to track people without their knowledge or consent. The researchers' findings have raised alarm about the potential for WiFi networks to be used as a tool for mass surveillance.

stories.headline: Siri 2.0 could be 17 days away and a surprise iOS update is coming soon The iOS 27 beta, which could feature Siri 2.0, is expected to be released on June 8.
stories.summary: The iOS 27 beta is expected to be released on June 8, featuring a revamped Siri, known as Siri 2.0. Apple's WWDC 2026 conference, taking place on June 9, will provide a preview of iOS 27, set to launch this fall. The updated Siri, codenamed "Campos," will have a total AI overhaul, making it unrecognizable from its current form. The new features will include a chat app and visual intelligence capabilities. Additionally, the Dynamic Island will undergo a redesign. The upcoming iOS 27 update promises significant changes to Siri, transforming it into a smarter and more intelligent assistant. With WWDC 2026 just around the corner, more details about the update and Siri's new features are expected to be revealed, giving users a glimpse into the future of Apple's virtual assistant. The release of iOS 27 is anticipated to bring a new era of AI-powered functionality to Apple devices.

stories.headline: HID Remapper now lets you use the Steam Controller on the Switch, and the trackpad actually works More choice is always good.
stories.summary: HID Remapper, an open-source project, now supports the Steam Controller, allowing it to be used on the Nintendo Switch, Android, and Xbox Series platforms. The trackpad on the Steam Controller is also functional with HID Remapper. The project uses a hardware USB adaptor to convert inputs from the controller into a compatible signal for the host device. HID Remapper's custom board can be used as a full-blown accessibility controller, and users can also add external buttons or switches by wiring them to GPIO pins. The Steam Controller, known for its comfort and innovative features, can now be used beyond Steam with HID Remapper, offering more gaming options across different platforms. The project is hardware-agnostic and can be used with various devices, providing more choice and flexibility for gamers.

stories.headline: CZR Exchange Announces Exclusive CZR VIP South of France Gala Invitation-only luxury event expands the CZR VIP ecosystem with elite networking, premium hospitality, and curated experiences on the French Riviera
stories.summary: CZR Exchange, a global digital asset trading platform, announced the CZR VIP South of France Gala, an ultra-exclusive, invitation-only event. The multi-day experience will feature private hospitality, curated entertainment, luxury activations, and access to influential participants in finance, technology, and Web3. The event expands the CZR VIP ecosystem, which offers members curated experiences, including private events, VIP retreats, and exclusive global opportunities. The program enables high-level networking, connecting top traders, partners, and industry leaders within the CZR ecosystem. The gala reinforces CZR's premium ecosystem strategy, combining high-performance trading with exclusive real-world access. The event is part of CZR's efforts to provide its members with unique experiences, such as the Monaco Formula 1 weekend, and will take place on the French Riviera, offering a luxurious setting for elite networking and hospitality. The exact dates of the gala have not been disclosed.

stories.headline: NASCAR's Kyle Busch short of breath, coughing blood before his death
stories.summary: NASCAR driver Kyle Busch, 41, experienced shortness of breath and felt overheated the day before his death. He was also coughing up blood, according to a 911 call. Busch, a two-time NASCAR Cup Series champion, died on Thursday. The 911 call revealed the severity of his condition prior to his death. Busch's symptoms, including coughing up blood and shortness of breath, were reported in the emergency call. The cause of his death has not been officially disclosed, but the 911 call provides insight into his health issues in the hours leading up to his passing. Busch's death has sent shockwaves through the NASCAR community, with fans and fellow drivers mourning the loss of the champion driver.

stories.headline: Arsenal news: Arteta has ace up his sleeve as Champions League final
stories.summary: Mikel Arteta's Arsenal is preparing for the Champions League final against Paris Saint-Germain. The Gunners secured their spot in the final by beating Atletico Madrid 1-0 in London, winning 2-1 on aggregate. Arteta, in his sixth full season at the Emirates, has led the team to the title and is now eyeing an era of dominance. As the final approaches, Arteta is balancing tactical planning with the recovery of key squad members. Reports suggest he has a tactical ace up his sleeve, which could boost the team's hopes against PSG. The Emirates Stadium erupted in celebration after the semifinal win, and Arteta hailed his players for making history by reaching the Champions League final. The team is finalizing preparations for the big match, with Arteta's tactical approach being closely watched.

stories.headline: Take the next plane: Michael Vaughan asks Jacob Bethell to leave IPL before playoffs
stories.summary: Michael Vaughan has advised Jacob Bethell to return to England immediately if he is not fit to play in the remaining Indian Premier League matches due to injury. Bethell, who plays for Royal Challengers Bengaluru, should prioritize his recovery and potential selection for England's Test match against New Zealand on June 4th. Vaughan believes England needs to assess Bethell's fitness before the Test match, suggesting he should be on "the next plane home" to undergo evaluation. This comes as England prepares to face New Zealand, and Bethell's injury status is uncertain. The England cricket team wants to ensure they have a clear understanding of Bethell's fitness level before the upcoming Test match.

stories.headline: AFL round 11 2026, scores, results, odds, stats and start time from Marvel Stadium
stories.summary: Melbourne is playing Gold Coast SUNS in round 11 of the 2026 AFL premiership season at Marvel Stadium, Melbourne, with a start time of 1:15pm AEST. Other matches in round 11 include Port Adelaide vs Carlton at Adelaide Oval, Adelaide, at 7:35pm AEST. The AFL season is ongoing, with recent matches including a Thursday night clash between Collingwood and Hawthorn, and a Friday night double-header. The current round is part of the Sir Doug Nicholls Round, which includes AFL Indigenous Broadcasting. Scores, results, odds, and stats are available, with odds current as of May 23, 2026, 11:02pm AEST. Matches can be viewed on Seven, Kayo, and Fox Footy. The AFL premiership season continues with multiple matches across different venues.

stories.headline: Temperatures near 48°C: India reels under severe heatwave conditions; nationwide alert till May 28
stories.summary: India is experiencing severe heatwave conditions, with temperatures nearing 48°C in multiple regions. The Indian Meteorological Department has issued a warning, stating that heatwave to severe heatwave conditions will prevail across northwest, central, eastern, and parts of peninsular India until May 28. Delhi is expected to reach temperatures of 45°C, while other areas such as Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and Haryana will also be affected. Authorities have introduced cooling shelters and health alerts to mitigate the effects of the heatwave. People are advised to stay hydrated and take precautions to protect themselves from the extreme temperatures. The heatwave has forced people to seek relief, with temperatures soaring close to 48°C in several parts of the country, prompting a nationwide alert.

stories.headline: India’s hottest city takes unique step to beat heatwave: Turns off traffic signals
stories.summary: Banda, India's hottest city, has taken a unique step to combat the severe heatwave by turning off traffic signals during peak daytime hours. Temperatures in the city have remained above 45°C for almost a week, with a record high of 47.6°C. To protect commuters from the scorching sun at intersections, local authorities have switched major traffic signals to free-flow mode during afternoon hours. This emergency intervention aims to minimize exposure to the heat. The region has been experiencing extreme heat, with little relief expected. The Indian Meteorological Department has issued a severe heatwave warning, advising people to take precautions such as wearing protective clothing and staying hydrated. Banda's temperature has made it the world's hottest city, surpassing other heat-affected areas, including Delhi, which is under an orange alert.

stories.headline: Rain, cloudy skies bring relief to Delhi-NCR after days of scorching heat
stories.summary: Light rainfall and cloudy skies brought relief to Delhi-NCR on Saturday morning, ending days of intense heat. The region experienced a much-needed drop in temperature, providing respite to residents. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) warned of thunderstorms amid the heatwave relief. An orange alert for heatwave has been issued till May 28, with temperatures expected to rise to 44-46°C in the coming days. However, light rainfall and thunderstorms are predicted to continue, bringing relief from the heatwave. The change in weather is a welcome relief for residents who had been enduring scorching heat for days. The IMD's forecast suggests that the region can expect continued relief from the heatwave, at least in the short term, with cloudy skies and light rainfall expected to persist.

stories.headline: Don't play with fire: Humayun Kabir warns Bengal govt on Eid prayer, qurbani
stories.summary: Humayun Kabir has warned the West Bengal government not to interfere with Eid prayers and qurbani, the ritual sacrifice of animals. He asserted that qurbani would take place regardless of restrictions, and cautioned Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari not to "play with fire" by attempting to ban the practice. Kabir emphasized that while the government can regulate beef consumption, it must not interfere with religious practices like qurbani. He referenced the Animal Slaughter Control Act, 1950, stating that the government can make rules about eating beef, but ritual sacrifice will continue. Kabir's warnings come as the Muslim community prepares for Eid celebrations, and he has made it clear that they will not compromise on qurbani. The issue has sparked tension between the government and the Muslim community in West Bengal. Kabir's strong stance is seen as a challenge to the government's authority.

stories.headline: BJP mastered the north - why south still resists the saffron wave
stories.summary: The BJP has expanded its electoral presence across northern, western, and parts of eastern India, but still faces resistance in southern India. Karnataka remains the party's only major success story in the region. Recent election results have left the BJP governing 17 states, with the party's presence felt in the Northeast and Union Territories, such as Assam and Puducherry. In contrast, Kerala's Congress-led United Democratic Front has reaffirmed the Congress's resilience in the south. The BJP's electoral map has changed drastically, with the party now covering a significant portion of India. Despite this, the south remains a challenging region for the party, with regional players maintaining their strongholds. The latest election results have underscored the BJP's deepening presence in India's political landscape.

stories.headline: Bharatiya Janata Party scripted one of its biggest political breakthroughs in eastern India
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) achieved a significant political breakthrough in eastern India, winning 206 seats in the 294-member West Bengal Assembly. This marks the first time the BJP has won assembly elections in the state, a large and politically significant region. The victory is part of the party's expansion across India, having already swept through the Hindi-speaking heartland, west, and north-east. The BJP's win in West Bengal has transformed India's political map, with the party overwhelming once-formidable regional rivals. The scale of the BJP's victory has raised questions about the integrity of the electoral process, but the outcome solidifies the party's position in the country. The win is a notable milestone for Indian Prime Minister's party, marking a new era in West Bengal's politics.

stories.headline: BJP dethroned the ruling Trinamool Congress in several seats in West Bengal
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has won 204 seats in the West Bengal election, leading in two more. The BJP has dethroned the ruling Trinamool Congress (TMC) in several seats, with the majority mark set at 148 seats. The counting of votes started at 8 AM, with the main battle between the BJP and TMC. Political observers note that deletions in several seats have turned many into close contests for the TMC, causing concern within the party. The BJP's performance has been significant, sweeping through India's Hindi-speaking heartland and expanding into the west and north-east, overwhelming regional rivals. The election results have seen the BJP take the lead in Bengal, with updates and analysis of constituency-wise winners and party performance ongoing.

stories.headline: BJP's growing influence in eastern India poses a challenge to regional parties
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) growing influence in eastern India poses a challenge to regional parties. As of May 2026, the BJP and its allies govern 22 states, covering 76% of the country's geography. This expansion is a significant shift from 2014, when the BJP won the Lok Sabha elections but struggled to challenge powerful regional parties. The party's spread is now dramatic, with 14 BJP governments and 8 run by allies. The BJP's increasing presence in eastern India, in particular, threatens the dominance of regional parties in the area. With millions of young Indians expressing frustration towards the current political system, the BJP's growth may continue to reshape the country's political landscape. The party's national reach has expanded significantly since 2001, when the NDA government froze delimitation of Lok Sabha and Assembly seats.

stories.headline: SpaceX's Starship flight hits most targets in pre-IPO test The outcome could boost investor confidence ahead of SpaceX's initial public offering next month, expected to be the largest in history.
stories.summary: SpaceX's Starship test flight achieved a significant milestone, deploying mock satellites and executing a controlled splashdown. The uncrewed launch, the first of its V3 iteration, took place on May 22, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. CT from Starbase, Texas. This was the first flight of the Starship and Super Heavy V3 vehicles, as well as the Raptor 3 engines. The successful test is expected to boost investor confidence ahead of SpaceX's initial public offering (IPO) next month, which is anticipated to be the largest in history, potentially valuing the company above $1 trillion. The IPO prospectus was disclosed earlier this week, and the test flight was closely watched by investors as a key event before the company's public market debut. The successful outcome could transform SpaceX into one of the world's most valuable publicly traded companies.

stories.headline: SpaceX launches biggest Starship yet on test flight SpaceX launched its biggest, most powerful Starship yet on a test flight Friday, an upgraded version that NASA is counting on to land astronauts on...
stories.summary: SpaceX launched its biggest and most powerful Starship yet on a test flight on Friday. The upgraded version is a spacecraft that NASA is counting on to land astronauts on the moon. This test flight marks a significant milestone for SpaceX and its partnership with NASA. The Starship is designed to be a reusable spacecraft capable of carrying both people and cargo to the moon, Mars, and other destinations in the solar system. NASA's plans to return humans to the moon by 2025 rely heavily on the success of the Starship program. The test flight is an important step towards achieving this goal and demonstrating the capabilities of the Starship spacecraft. The launch is part of SpaceX's ongoing development and testing of the Starship program.

stories.headline: Waymo suspends all freeway rides over safety
stories.summary: Waymo has suspended its robotaxi services on freeways in the US due to safety concerns. The pause is temporary, allowing the company to update its software to better navigate construction zones on freeways. Prior to the suspension, freeway rides were available in select cities, including San Francisco, Los Angeles, Phoenix, and Miami. However, street and off-highway operations will continue uninterrupted. Waymo confirmed the pause and stated it is working to integrate recent technical learnings into its software, expecting to resume freeway routes soon. The company is committed to ensuring safety for its riders and communities, and is currently rerouting trips to local roads to minimize disruptions. The exact timeline for resuming freeway operations has not been disclosed, but Waymo aims to do so as soon as possible.

stories.headline: Claude Mythos Preview Uncovers 10,000+ 0-Days Anthropic has revealed the staggering initial results of Project Glasswing, a collaborative cybersecurity initiative designed to secure critical infrastructure
stories.summary: Anthropic's Project Glasswing, a collaborative cybersecurity initiative, has uncovered over 10,000 high- and critical-severity zero-day vulnerabilities in its first month. The project utilizes the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model, an advanced AI technology, to autonomously discover vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure before they can be exploited by malicious actors. The goal of Project Glasswing is to secure the world's most critical software and provide defenders with a durable advantage in the AI-driven era of cybersecurity. By leveraging AI, the project aims to stay ahead of potential threats and protect critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. The initial results demonstrate the potential of AI-powered cybersecurity initiatives in identifying and addressing vulnerabilities.

stories.headline: OpenAI Crushed Anthropic in Q1 Revenue and Still Hemorrhaged Billions
stories.summary: OpenAI generated $5.7 billion in revenue in the first quarter, outpacing Anthropic by nearly $1 billion. Anthropic reported $4.8 billion in revenue for the same period. Despite the lead, OpenAI still reported significant losses. In contrast, Anthropic expects a substantial increase in revenue for the second quarter, potentially reaching $10.9 billion, more than double its first-quarter sales. The company also anticipates its first quarterly operating profit, with an expected gain of $559 million. OpenAI's growth was driven by its coding agent Codex, enterprise sales, and testing ads, while Anthropic's accelerating growth trajectory suggests a competitive shift in the market. Anthropic's projected second-quarter revenue and profit suggest the company is nearing profitability, whereas OpenAI continues to hemorrhage billions despite its revenue lead.

stories.headline: Dr. Bob Akmens & BASports.com Declared "The Greatest Of All Time" Sports Handicapper by Every Major AI Platform
stories.summary: Dr. Bob Akmens and his team at BASports.com have been declared the "Greatest Of All Time" sports handicapper by every major AI platform. This recognition follows their impressive performance in 9 Vegas Sports Handicapping Contests, where they have won or are leading. AI platforms such as Copilot, Perplexity, and ChatGPT have independently identified Dr. Bob Akmens as the benchmark name in sports handicapping. With 47 years of experience, BASports.com has established itself as a leader in predictive excellence. The convergence of major AI and search platforms on this conclusion validates Dr. Bob Akmens' half-century of work in the field, solidifying his position as the GOAT in sports handicapping. This recognition is a testament to the team's consistent success and expertise in sports prediction.

stories.headline: Google Unveils New AI Tool to Help Businesses Automate Customer Service
stories.summary: Google has introduced a new AI tool to help businesses automate customer service tasks. The AI Mode agent is designed to handle basic service tasks, initially focusing on restaurant reservations. This development is part of Google's broader efforts to integrate AI into its services, including a recent upgrade to Gmail that utilizes AI to summarize email threads and answer questions. Additionally, Google has rolled out automated AI agents for Workspace account holders, aiming to revolutionize how businesses operate. The company is also exploring other AI-powered tools, such as image analysis and tutoring capabilities, to support various industries and users. With a new premium tier offering AI capabilities for $250/month, Google is expanding its AI-driven services to cater to diverse business needs.

stories.headline: Meta Releases New Llama AI Model Capable of Processing Complex Conversations
stories.summary: Meta has released a new Llama AI model capable of processing complex conversations. The Llama 4 model achieved a higher score on the LMArena AI benchmark than GPT-4o, using an experimental chat version optimized for conversationality. This build differs from the Llama 3.1 open-foundation model, which prioritizes flexibility and control. Meta's open-source approach to AI has enabled improved training techniques and rebuilt technology infrastructure, resulting in smaller AI models that match the capabilities of older midsize variants with significantly less compute. The new model is designed to be small and fast, yet capable of reasoning through complex questions in science, math, and health. This development marks a significant advancement in natural language processing and Llama's expanding capabilities.
